title: Run live self-host public acceptance

context.summary: Run and harden the complete live self-host acceptance path with Docker.
context.background: The public version must be proven from a clean temporary home using real runtime services and installer lifecycle operations.

in: Run clean temp MINDORY_HOME installer start with Docker.
Exercise sync antivirus, pgvector, Qdrant, Docling, upload, jobs, search and context.
Run backup, restore or reset, remote update and uninstall acceptance.
Fix failures found in the live path.
out: Publishing a real public release tag.

acceptance_criteria: Live self-host acceptance starts from a clean temporary MINDORY_HOME.
Acceptance covers sync AV, pgvector, Qdrant and Docling profiles.
Upload, processing, search, context, backup, update and uninstall flows pass.
Failures produce actionable diagnostics and leave no unmanaged runtime state.

manual_checks: Confirm Docker is running before live acceptance.
Confirm temporary MINDORY_HOME is removed or intentionally preserved only on failure.

risks: Live acceptance can be slow and depends on local Docker resources.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
